description: Defines the StreamWrapper class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which provides a PHP stream wrapper for Guzzle streams, allowing them to be used as PHP stream resources.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: Provides a PHP stream wrapper for Guzzle streams, enabling them to be used as native PHP stream resources.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns a resource representing the stream.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a stream context that can be used to open a stream as a PHP stream resource.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the stream wrapper if needed.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream based on the provided context.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns a resource handle for the stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns statistical information about the stream.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Provides status information about a URL.
